newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy stock market needs cost cuts - Padoa-Schioppa.
newsitem.headline: Italy stock market needs cost cuts - Padoa-Schioppa.

text.p: The Italian stock market needs to reduce costs and give a better service if it is to play a greater role in international equities, said Bank of Italy vice director general Tommaso Padoa-Schioppa at a conference.
He added that due to actual reforms in place the organisation of the market and regulations were already in line with many international stock exchanges.
But he added that to follow these markets, the Italian stock market needs more fiscal incentive to invest and a less uncertain legal system.
"These inefficiencies are particularly dangerous for the development of the market, and could result in operators transfering their business to other stock markets," he said.
